newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian singer Nascimento in hospital, improving.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian singer Nascimento in hospital, improving.

text.p: Popular Brazilian singer Milton Nascimento has been admitted to a hospital because of metabolic complications connected with diabetes, and his condition is improving, a hospital spokeswoman said on Friday.
She said Nascimento went into the hospital on Wednesday evening and doctors expected to release him in five to seven days.
Nascimento, 54, was only recently diagnosed as diabetic.
He is one of Brazil's best-known artists internationally and has recorded with jazz stars Herbie Hancock and Wayne Shorter.
Nascimento, a black shantytown orphan before being adopted by white parents, was raised in the southeastern state of Minas Gerais and now lives in Rio de Janeiro.
